correctness.rationale: The actual 54 listed tetrahedra have f=(12,66,108,54) and complete 1-skeleton. Collapsing the vertex-1 star tree gives 55 cotree coordinates, 108 facial relations and mod-2 rank 53, which I independently reconstructed. The source gives two explicit integer cocycles annihilating every facial boundary and a specified 53×53 minor of determinant 1: hence H1 is torsion-free Z², with the (23),(26) cotree cycles furnishing an integral basis by determinant −1. An exhaustive, incidence-preserving vertex backtracker identifies 24 automorphisms (also independently rerun). Evaluation of both homology classes against the cocycles yields 12 distinct integer 2×2 matrices, each twice. Their q=x²+xy+y² invariance and full count follow by exhausting all q-unit integral columns; reduction yields GL(2,F2), size six. No claim about other triangulations or mapping class groups.
